-- =============================================================================
-- FIN_FORECAST Consolidated BigQuery SQL
-- Final Consumer: CV_COMP_FIN_FORECAST
-- Generated by: BigQuery SQL Consolidation Agent
-- Runtime Parameters:
--   @ip_version        STRING  - Version filter applied to weekly forecast and comp flag data
--   @ip_week_ending_from STRING - Start of fiscal week range (bic_zio_sweek >= this value)
--   @ip_week_ending_to   STRING - End of fiscal week range (bic_zio_sweek <= this value)
-- =============================================================================

WITH

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 1: WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05
-- Logic: Projects and filters weekly financial forecast data from the
--        physical source table. Applies hardcoded fiscal variant filter
--        (fiscvarnt = 'K4'), week range filter using runtime parameters,
--        version filter, and audit type filter. Renames source columns
--        bic_zio_pctr -> b631_s_proftctr, bic_zio_cctr -> b631_s_costcntr,
--        and b631_s_amount -> b631_s_amount_negative per CV_BASE_FIN_WEEKLY_FORECAST_S4.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds041
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200'); fiscvarnt = 'K4';
--          bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to;
--          bic_zio_ver = @ip_version; bic_zio_saudt IN ('1','10')
-- =====================================================================
WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05 AS (
  SELECT
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    mandt,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    b631_s_chrtacct,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    bic_zio_pctr        AS b631_s_proftctr,
    bic_zio_cctr        AS b631_s_costcntr,
    b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    b631_s_gl_acct,
    bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    b631_s_amount       AS b631_s_amount_negative,
    currency,
    bic_zio_amt
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds041`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('120', '200')
    AND fiscvarnt = 'K4'
    AND bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
    AND bic_zio_ver = @ip_version
    AND bic_zio_saudt IN ('1', '10')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 2: STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL
-- Logic: Projects store profile attribute data from the physical source
--        table. Filters on mandt. Provides store dimension attributes
--        for joining to weekly forecast data. Aggregates measures
--        (rx_hrs_oper, fs_hrs_oper, retail_sqft_amt, total_sqft_amt)
--        per CV_BASE_MD_SRPACT_S4 CUBE semantics.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')
-- Aggregation: SUM of measure columns; GROUP BY all non-measure columns
-- =====================================================================
STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    strnum,
    prctr,
    kokrs,
    kostl,
    rx_open_dat,
    rx_close_dat,
    fs_open_dat,
    fs_close_dat,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    address,
    city,
    state,
    zipcode,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    division_mgr,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    area_mgr,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    region_mgr,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zone_code,
    district_mgr,
    zone_desc,
    major_region_code,
    major_region,
    store_type,
    store_type_desc,
    rx_store,
    rx_store_desc,
    distribution_cntr,
    distribution_cntr_desc,
    store_24_hr,
    budget_open_dat,
    budget_closed_dat,
    budget_reloc_dat,
    const_open_dat,
    const_close_dat,
    const_relo_dat,
    relocation_dat,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    budget_emerg_mkt_ind,
    company_code,
    company_code_desc,
    original_fs_open_dat,
    original_rx_open_dat,
    group_one,
    group_two,
    ard_sort_key,
    area_cost_center,
    regiion_cost_center,
    county_code,
    county_desc,
    sqft_bracket_desc,
    sqft_sort_key,
    acquisition_code,
    acquisition_desc,
    photo_lab_add_dat,
    photo_lab_close_dat,
    min_hrs_ind,
    createdby,
    created_on,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code,
    SUM(rx_hrs_oper)      AS rx_hrs_oper,
    SUM(fs_hrs_oper)      AS fs_hrs_oper,
    SUM(retail_sqft_amt)  AS retail_sqft_amt,
    SUM(total_sqft_amt)   AS total_sqft_amt
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
  GROUP BY
    mandt, strnum, prctr, kokrs, kostl, rx_open_dat, rx_close_dat,
    fs_open_dat, fs_close_dat, rep_mkt_code, rep_mkt_desc, address,
    city, state, zipcode, division_code, division_desc, division_mgr,
    area_code, area_desc, area_mgr, region_code, region_desc, region_mgr,
    district_code, district_desc, zone_code, district_mgr, zone_desc,
    major_region_code, major_region, store_type, store_type_desc,
    rx_store, rx_store_desc, distribution_cntr, distribution_cntr_desc,
    store_24_hr, budget_open_dat, budget_closed_dat, budget_reloc_dat,
    const_open_dat, const_close_dat, const_relo_dat, relocation_dat,
    emerg_mkt_ind, budget_emerg_mkt_ind, company_code, company_code_desc,
    original_fs_open_dat, original_rx_open_dat, group_one, group_two,
    ard_sort_key, area_cost_center, regiion_cost_center, county_code,
    county_desc, sqft_bracket_desc, sqft_sort_key, acquisition_code,
    acquisition_desc, photo_lab_add_dat, photo_lab_close_dat, min_hrs_ind,
    createdby, created_on, rx_division_code, rx_area_code, rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 3: Joined_Weekly_Store
-- Logic: Left-joins weekly forecast snapshot with store attributes on
--        profit center (b631_s_proftctr = prctr). Combines fact and
--        store dimension columns. Adds CAL_STORE_WEEK_NUMBER as the
--        rightmost 2 characters of bic_zio_sweek (WEEK_NUMBER node).
-- Source: WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05 (left), STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on f.b631_s_proftctr = s.prctr
-- Calculation: RIGHT(bic_zio_sweek, 2) AS cal_store_week_number
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Weekly_Store AS (
  SELECT
    f.fiscper,
    f.fiscvarnt,
    f.fiscyear,
    f.fiscper3,
    f.mandt,
    f.bic_zio_sweek,
    f.b631_s_chrtacct,
    f.b631_s_co_area,
    f.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    f.b631_s_proftctr,
    f.b631_s_costcntr,
    f.b631_s_funcarea,
    f.bic_zio_ver,
    f.bic_zio_saudt,
    f.b631_s_gl_acct,
    f.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    f.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    f.b631_s_amount_negative,
    f.currency,
    f.bic_zio_amt,
    s.rep_mkt_code,
    s.rep_mkt_desc,
    s.emerg_mkt_ind,
    s.division_code,
    s.division_desc,
    s.region_code,
    s.region_desc,
    s.district_code,
    s.district_desc,
    s.area_code,
    s.area_desc,
    s.strnum,
    s.city,
    s.state,
    s.fs_open_dat,
    s.rx_open_dat,
    s.rx_division_code,
    s.rx_area_code,
    s.rx_region_code,
    s.rx_district_code,
    RIGHT(f.bic_zio_sweek, 2) AS cal_store_week_number
  FROM WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05 f
  LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL s
    ON f.b631_s_proftctr = s.prctr
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 4: COMP_FLAG_FORECAST
-- Logic: Projects comp flag data from the physical source table.
--        Filters on mandt and on comp_ver = @ip_version (runtime parameter).
--        Provides FS and RX comp week flags for joining to forecast data.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl
-- Filters: mandt IN ('110','200'); comp_ver = @ip_version
-- =====================================================================
COMP_FLAG_FORECAST AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    strnum,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk,
    zweek,
    zmonth,
    zyear,
    comp_ver
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('110', '200')
    AND comp_ver = @ip_version
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 5: Joined_Weekly_CompFlag
-- Logic: Left-joins the weekly/store joined data with comp flag forecast
--        on profit center and fiscal week. Adds fs_comp_wk and rx_comp_wk
--        dimension columns from comp flag data.
-- Source: Joined_Weekly_Store (left), COMP_FLAG_FORECAST (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on w.b631_s_proftctr = c.prctr
--                AND w.bic_zio_sweek = c.zweek
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Weekly_CompFlag AS (
  SELECT
    w.fiscper,
    w.fiscvarnt,
    w.fiscyear,
    w.fiscper3,
    w.mandt,
    w.bic_zio_sweek,
    w.b631_s_chrtacct,
    w.b631_s_co_area,
    w.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    w.b631_s_proftctr,
    w.b631_s_costcntr,
    w.b631_s_funcarea,
    w.bic_zio_ver,
    w.bic_zio_saudt,
    w.b631_s_gl_acct,
    w.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    w.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    w.b631_s_amount_negative,
    w.currency,
    w.bic_zio_amt,
    w.rep_mkt_code,
    w.rep_mkt_desc,
    w.emerg_mkt_ind,
    w.division_code,
    w.division_desc,
    w.region_code,
    w.region_desc,
    w.district_code,
    w.district_desc,
    w.area_code,
    w.area_desc,
    w.strnum,
    w.city,
    w.state,
    w.fs_open_dat,
    w.rx_open_dat,
    w.rx_division_code,
    w.rx_area_code,
    w.rx_region_code,
    w.rx_district_code,
    w.cal_store_week_number,
    c.fs_comp_wk,
    c.rx_comp_wk
  FROM Joined_Weekly_Store w
  LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG_FORECAST c
    ON w.b631_s_proftctr = c.prctr
   AND w.bic_zio_sweek = c.zweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 6: CAL_WEEK
-- Logic: Projects calendar week data from the physical source table.
--        Filters on rclnt. Provides week start and end dates for joining
--        to forecast data.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek
-- Filters: rclnt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
CAL_WEEK AS (
  SELECT
    zzweek,
    zrwstrtdate,
    zrwenddate,
    rclnt
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek`
  WHERE rclnt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 7: Joined_Weekly_CalWeek
-- Logic: Left-joins the weekly/store/compflag joined data with calendar
--        week data on fiscal week (bic_zio_sweek = zzweek). Adds week
--        start date (zrwstrtdate) and week end date (zrwenddate).
-- Source: Joined_Weekly_CompFlag (left), CAL_WEEK (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j.bic_zio_sweek = cal.zzweek
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Weekly_CalWeek AS (
  SELECT
    j.fiscper,
    j.fiscvarnt,
    j.fiscyear,
    j.fiscper3,
    j.mandt,
    j.bic_zio_sweek,
    j.b631_s_chrtacct,
    j.b631_s_co_area,
    j.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    j.b631_s_proftctr,
    j.b631_s_costcntr,
    j.b631_s_funcarea,
    j.bic_zio_ver,
    j.bic_zio_saudt,
    j.b631_s_gl_acct,
    j.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    j.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    j.b631_s_amount_negative,
    j.currency,
    j.bic_zio_amt,
    j.rep_mkt_code,
    j.rep_mkt_desc,
    j.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j.division_code,
    j.division_desc,
    j.region_code,
    j.region_desc,
    j.district_code,
    j.district_desc,
    j.area_code,
    j.area_desc,
    j.strnum,
    j.city,
    j.state,
    j.fs_open_dat,
    j.rx_open_dat,
    j.rx_division_code,
    j.rx_area_code,
    j.rx_region_code,
    j.rx_district_code,
    j.cal_store_week_number,
    j.fs_comp_wk,
    j.rx_comp_wk,
    cal.zrwstrtdate,
    cal.zrwenddate
  FROM Joined_Weekly_CompFlag j
  LEFT JOIN CAL_WEEK cal
    ON j.bic_zio_sweek = cal.zzweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 8: PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Logic: Projects profit center text data from the physical source table.
--        Filters on mandt. Provides profit center long text (ltext) for
--        joining to forecast data, aliased as profit_center_text.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    ltext AS profit_center_text
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 9: FLAGS
-- Logic: Left-joins the fully joined weekly data with profit center text
--        on profit center (b631_s_proftctr = prctr). Adds calculated
--        columns: cal_fs_rx_flag (FS/RX flag from bic_zwwpc_pa1 prefix),
--        cal_comp_flag (comp week flag based on cal_fs_rx_flag),
--        cal_week_number (rightmost 2 chars of bic_zio_sweek),
--        and b631_s_amount (b631_s_amount_negative * -1).
--        This CTE represents the final pre-aggregation projection node
--        (FLAGS) from CV_COMP_FIN_FORECAST.
-- Source: Joined_Weekly_CalWeek (left), PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j.b631_s_proftctr = p.prctr
-- Calculation:
--   cal_fs_rx_flag: CASE on LEFT(bic_zwwpc_pa1,2) IN ('FS','RX')
--   cal_comp_flag:  CASE on cal_fs_rx_flag -> fs_comp_wk / rx_comp_wk
--   cal_week_number: RIGHT(bic_zio_sweek, 2)
--   b631_s_amount:  b631_s_amount_negative * -1
-- =====================================================================
FLAGS AS (
  SELECT
    j.rx_comp_wk,
    j.fs_comp_wk,
    j.fiscper,
    j.fiscvarnt,
    j.fiscyear,
    j.fiscper3,
    j.mandt,
    j.bic_zio_sweek,
    j.b631_s_chrtacct,
    j.b631_s_co_area,
    j.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    j.b631_s_proftctr,
    j.b631_s_costcntr,
    j.b631_s_funcarea,
    j.bic_zio_ver,
    j.bic_zio_saudt,
    j.b631_s_gl_acct,
    j.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    j.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    j.b631_s_amount_negative,
    j.currency,
    j.bic_zio_amt,
    j.rep_mkt_code,
    j.rep_mkt_desc,
    j.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j.division_code,
    j.division_desc,
    j.region_code,
    j.region_desc,
    j.district_code,
    j.district_desc,
    j.area_code,
    j.area_desc,
    j.strnum,
    j.zrwstrtdate,
    j.zrwenddate,
    j.city,
    j.state,
    p.profit_center_text,
    j.fs_open_dat,
    j.rx_open_dat,
    j.rx_division_code,
    j.rx_area_code,
    j.rx_region_code,
    j.rx_district_code,
    -- CAL_FS_RX_FLAG: derived from leftmost 2 chars of bic_zwwpc_pa1
    CASE
      WHEN LEFT(j.bic_zwwpc_pa1, 2) = 'FS' THEN 'FS'
      WHEN LEFT(j.bic_zwwpc_pa1, 2) = 'RX' THEN 'RX'
      ELSE ''
    END AS cal_fs_rx_flag,
    -- CAL_COMP_FLAG: comp week flag based on FS/RX classification
    CASE
      WHEN LEFT(j.bic_zwwpc_pa1, 2) = 'FS' THEN j.fs_comp_wk
      WHEN LEFT(j.bic_zwwpc_pa1, 2) = 'RX' THEN j.rx_comp_wk
      ELSE j.fs_comp_wk
    END AS cal_comp_flag,
    -- CAL_WEEK_NUMBER: rightmost 2 chars of bic_zio_sweek
    RIGHT(j.bic_zio_sweek, 2) AS cal_week_number,
    -- B631_S_AMOUNT: negation of b631_s_amount_negative
    (j.b631_s_amount_negative * -1) AS b631_s_amount
  FROM Joined_Weekly_CalWeek j
  LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT p
    ON j.b631_s_proftctr = p.prctr
)

-- =====================================================================
-- Final SELECT: CV_COMP_FIN_FORECAST Aggregated Output
-- Logic: Aggregates the FLAGS CTE output per CUBE semantics.
--        Groups by all non-measure dimension and calculated columns.
--        Aggregates measures: b631_s_amount_negative, bic_zio_amt,
--        and b631_s_amount (the calculated negation measure).
--        cal_fs_rx_flag is output as fs_rx_flag (meaningful rename).
--        cal_comp_flag is output as comp_flag (meaningful rename).
-- Aggregation: SUM(b631_s_amount_negative), SUM(bic_zio_amt),
--              SUM(b631_s_amount); GROUP BY all dimension columns
-- =====================================================================
SELECT
  mandt,
  fiscper,
  fiscvarnt,
  fiscyear,
  fiscper3,
  bic_zio_sweek,
  b631_s_chrtacct,
  b631_s_co_area,
  bic_zio_cmpcd,
  b631_s_proftctr,
  cal_fs_rx_flag          AS fs_rx_flag,
  b631_s_costcntr,
  b631_s_funcarea,
  bic_zio_ver,
  bic_zio_saudt,
  b631_s_gl_acct,
  bic_zwwpc_pa1,
  bic_zwwsc_pa1,
  currency,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  fs_comp_wk,
  rx_comp_wk,
  cal_comp_flag           AS comp_flag,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  region_code,
  region_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  strnum,
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  cal_week_number,
  city,
  state,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code,
  -- Aggregated measures
  SUM(b631_s_amount_negative) AS b631_s_amount_negative,
  SUM(bic_zio_amt)            AS bic_zio_amt,
  SUM(b631_s_amount)          AS b631_s_amount
FROM FLAGS
GROUP BY
  mandt,
  fiscper,
  fiscvarnt,
  fiscyear,
  fiscper3,
  bic_zio_sweek,
  b631_s_chrtacct,
  b631_s_co_area,
  bic_zio_cmpcd,
  b631_s_proftctr,
  cal_fs_rx_flag,
  b631_s_costcntr,
  b631_s_funcarea,
  bic_zio_ver,
  bic_zio_saudt,
  b631_s_gl_acct,
  bic_zwwpc_pa1,
  bic_zwwsc_pa1,
  currency,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  fs_comp_wk,
  rx_comp_wk,
  cal_comp_flag,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  region_code,
  region_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  strnum,
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  cal_week_number,
  city,
  state,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code
